title: The World of Prefixes and Suffixes
summary: Discover how Spanish words change when prefixes are added at the beginning or suffixes at the end.
keyIdeas: Prefixes go before a base word or root to form a new word with a different meaning.
Suffixes go after a base or root and can form words for jobs, places or qualities.
Recognising a root or base word can help you understand unfamiliar words.

basicKnowledge: D. Reflexión sobre la lengua y sus usos en el marco de propuestas de producción y comprensión de textos orales, escritos o multimodales

activities.prompt: In «submarino», «sub-» is a prefix because it comes before the base.
activities.explanation: True. Prefixes go before the base or root to change its meaning. Here, «sub-» means 'under'.

activities.prompt: Sort these Spanish words by the part studied here: prefixes des-, im-, re- or suffixes -ería, -ario, -ista.
activities.explanation: Focus on «des-», «im-» and «re-» in «deshacer», «imposible» and «recolocar». Focus on «-ería», «-ario» and «-ista» in «panadería», «campanario» and «violinista». A word can contain more than one added part.

activities.prompt: Match each Spanish prefix with the meaning it adds in the example.
activities.explanation: In these examples, «des-» reverses an action, «re-» repeats it, «pre-» means 'before' and «sub-» means 'under'.

activities.prompt: Complete the Spanish sentence with the word naming a job.
activities.explanation: The suffix «-ero» can form words for jobs, such as «jardinero».
activities.hint: Choose the word that names a person.
activities.sentence: La persona que diseña y construye jardines con plantas preciosas es un gran ___.

activities.prompt: Aisha says «pescado» has the prefix «pes-». Is she right?
activities.explanation: Not every initial group of letters is a prefix. «Pescado» comes from «pescar» and has no prefix.
options: Yes, because all aquatic animals have a prefix.
No, because «pescado» comes from «pescar» and has no prefix.
Yes, because «pes-» is at the beginning of the word.

activities.prompt: Read the Spanish text about the school workshop and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: «Ultrarrápido» has the prefix «ultra-», and «jardinera» has the suffix «-era».
activities.title: El invento de Mateo
activities.text: En el taller de ciencias, Mateo presentó su invento: un monopatín ultrarrápido con ruedas recargables. Su amiga Martina, que sueña con ser jardinera, lo examinó con curiosidad. Mateo explicó que el motor era completamente silencioso para no molestar a los vecinos. Toda la clase aplaudió entusiasmada al ver que el vehículo se movía con suavidad por el patio.

questions.prompt: Which word in the text has a prefix meaning 'very' or 'to an extreme degree'?
questions.explanation: «Ultra-» can mean 'very' or 'to a degree beyond the usual'.

questions.prompt: In «jardinera», what does the suffix «-era» add?
options: The idea of undoing an action.
The name of a person who works caring for gardens.
questions.explanation: In «jardinera», «-era» helps form a job name from «jardín».

activities.prompt: Find the mistake. In which Spanish sentence is the prefixed word used incorrectly?
activities.explanation: To make a desk tidy, use «ordenar», not «desordenar». Here, «des-» reverses the action.
activities.hint: Find the action that does not fit the intended result.
options: Martina intentó desordenar su mesa para que quedase limpia y recogida.
Hugo metió la tarta en el horno para descongelarla antes de comer.
El árbitro consideró que la jugada era legal y continuó el partido.

activities.prompt: Put this guide to forming a Spanish word meaning 'read again' in order.
activities.explanation: Adding «re-» to «leer» forms «releer», which means 'read again'.
items: Choose the prefix «re-» to show repetition.

activities.prompt: Choose the correctly formed Spanish word to complete the sentence.
activities.explanation: «Increíble» combines «in-» and «creíble». The prefix becomes «im-» before b or p, as in «imposible».
activities.hint: Think of «creíble» and the prefix that gives it a negative meaning.
activities.sentence: La noticia era tan extraña que a todos les pareció algo completamente ___.

activities.prompt: Omar invents a name for a shop selling notebooks. Which Spanish suffix for a place should he use?
activities.explanation: «-ería» can name a shop or business, as in «pastelería» or «frutería».
